title: BRIDGE DIFFUSION MODEL: BRIDGE NON-ENGLISH LANGUAGE-NATIVE TEXT-TO-IMAGE DIFFUSION MODEL WITH ENGLISH COMMUNITIES

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of the model's ability to accurately generate culturally specific non-English concepts (e.g., Chinese traditional clothing, native cuisine, and architecture) from native-language text prompts, comparing the results against the typical English-centric representations of baseline text-to-image models.
